newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Commercial creates mortgage unit.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Commercial creates mortgage unit.

text.p: Pioneer Commercial Funding Corp said on Friday it entered into an agreement to create a new mortgage banking division called Pioneer Home Funding LLC.
The new division will originate, acquire and sell mortage loans on residential properties on a wholesale and retail basis, Pioneer said.
Pioneer will have an 80 percent interest and the balance will be owned by Thomas Evans III, who will serve as president and chief executive.

The new division, which will begin operations out of Phoenix and Southern California, will benefit from the availability of funds from a $25 million credit facility recently obtained by Pioneer Commercial Funding, the company said.
